i.norm:
Verifies the Levenshtein distance between two character sequences that differ only in where the single non-null character 'f' is placed (and in their lengths), using a threshold-limited distance instance.

The left sequence has length 7 with 'f' at index 3; the rest are the default '�' characters. The right sequence has length 8 with 'f' at indices 2, 6 and 7. Transforming left into right requires 3 edits, which is within the configured threshold of 7.
Left sequence: length 7, only index 3 holds 'f', rest are '�'.
Right sequence: length 8, with 'f' at indices 2, 6 and 7, rest '�'.
A threshold of 7 still allows the actual distance (3) to be returned.
